<thought>The SMILES O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2 is valid and corresponds to benzophenone (C13H10O). Its molecular weight (C13H10O) is 182.07 g/mol, matching the observed m/z 182.073 (likely [M+H]⁺). The 13C NMR shows a carbonyl carbon around 196 ppm and aromatic carbons consistent with two phenyl rings, supporting this structure. Therefore, the SMILES string for the compound is correct.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2</final_answer>
